GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 560 (17 Nov 45) ESS-IE
(SCAPIN - 298)
APO 500
17 November 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : Imperial Japanese Government
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo
SUBJECT : Shipment of 3,000 Tons Pitch to Korea
1. It is directed that 3,000 tons of pitch be shipped to Pusan, Korea. The shipment will be consigned to Commanding General, United States Forces in Korea.
2. You will advise this headquarters of the expected date of shipment and name of steamer.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
/s/ H. W. Allen
/t/ H. W. ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst. Adjutant General
